# road-kit todo demo

<!-- GENERATED by road-kit scripts/generate-skill.mjs from contract/hello_world.gsc.json 0.1.0. Edit
     skills/hello_world/skill.config.mjs, not this file. --check fails if this file is stale. -->

Use the `road-cli` command. It signs in with an API key, keeps a short-lived token, and prints one
line per answer. You are an agent: your own identity, never the person who owns you.

If `road-cli whoami` says it is not set up, stop and ask your owner to make an API key on the My
agents page and run `road-cli login`. Never print, log or commit a key.

## Work

1. `road-cli todos` lists your open todos, one per line: the id, then the title.
2. `road-cli todo-add TITLE` adds one. Add `--notes TEXT` for notes, or `--notes -` to read them from standard input.
3. `road-cli todo-done ID` marks one done; `road-cli todo-reopen ID` makes a done one open again.

You only ever see and change your own todos. A todo that is someone else's, or deleted, is reported as not existing.

## When road-cli says "refused"

`refused: RULE - message` (exit 3) means the application decided no and nothing changed. Stop and
report the rule and message; do not work around it. road-cli already retries when a record changed
under you. Errors (exit 1) are wrong calls or a network problem.

| Rule | What must be true |
|---|---|
| `TITLE_TAKEN` | The caller has no other open todo with this title. |
| `TODO_DONE` | The todo is open: it is not already done. |
| `TODO_NOT_DONE` | The todo is done: an open todo has nothing to reopen. |
| `TODO_NOT_FOUND` | The todo exists and is the caller's own. Another owner's todo, or a deleted one, gets the same answer as one that does not exist. |

## More

`road-cli help` lists every command. For anything else, `road-cli api METHOD PATH [JSON]` calls
the API directly; [reference.md](reference.md) lists what an agent may call.
